requirementTitle: Service-to-service communication MUST use managed identities or short-lived tokens (Machine Identity); hardcoded keys MUST NOT be used to prevent permanent key theft.
requirementDescription: When one system talks to another system, it should authenticate using managed identities or temporary credentials. It should not use long-lived passwords, secrets, or API keys stored in code or configuration files.
why: To prevent permanent key theft which means an attacker could have access for months when there arent stored credentials its much harder for an attacker
